_README: Copy to <your-device>.json and fill from the vendor datasheet + your own probes. Every ceiling tool reads this via --device / DEVICE_CFG. setup and the ceilings runner pick the file whose platform and device_name_match fit the machine, and (jetson) whose required_power_mode matches the current mode.
device_name_match: substring that must appear in the nvidia-smi GPU name
vram_note: null = auto-detect at run time; set a cap only as a deliberate budget policy

datasheet.source_url: the public product page these came from
datasheet.notes: dense (non-sparse) figures; record how any sparse headline was de-rated

power_sources.note: where power.draw is read (sysfs rail on jetson, NVML on discrete)

sampler_period_note: avoid a period that phase-locks to the workload's frame rate

emc_dial.note: memory-clock bins the causal bytes/frame dial can step through, if supported

ops_per_tinst.note: per-arch tensor-instruction op counts; calibrate once against the known-truth GEMM before any roofline

quirks: free-text notes on this part's measured behaviour under lock
_platform_note: set to "jetson" or "discrete" (must be exactly one; this decides every platform-specific branch)
